correctness.rationale: A complete 2^14 enumeration supports a 910-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching on 1849 augmented faces with exactly 29 five-critical cells, giving an integral wedge of 29 S5. No nonempty face has a nontrivial translation stabilizer, hence the geometric orbit space has universal cover X, pi1=C7. Cartan–Leray and the standard periodic resolution compute low integral homology including H1=H3=Z/7; Euler characteristic and top-cell freeness give H5=Z^5. Lefschetz traces determine Q plus four rational regular C7 modules. A standalone integer quotient chain generator checks signed d²=0 and Betti ranks modulo 2,3,7; proofs do not extrapolate finite samples.
